query.help: Search for items on Lenovo. Example: lenovo search query "my search term" --limit 20 --table lenovo search query "keyword" --filter "price:lt:100" lenovo search query "keyword" --properties "title,price"
query.usage_instructions: Use `lenovo search query` when you need to search for items on lenovo. Required arguments: query. Common flags: --limit/-l, --filter/-f, --table/-t, --properties/-p.

item.help: Get details for a specific item. Example: lenovo search item abc123 --table lenovo search item "https://example.com/item/abc123" lenovo search item abc123 --properties "title,price"
item.usage_instructions: Use `lenovo search item` when you need to get details for a specific item. Required arguments: item_id. Common flags: --table/-t, --properties/-p.

list.help: List items from Lenovo. Example: lenovo search list --limit 100 --table lenovo search list --filter "status:active" lenovo search list --properties "id,name,status"
list.usage_instructions: Use `lenovo search list` when you need to list items from lenovo. Common flags: --limit/-l, --filter/-f, --table/-t, --properties/-p.

wildcard.help: Search items with wildcard pattern matching. Supports * wildcards for pattern matching across all string fields. Browser CLIs use client-side search.
wildcard.usage_instructions: Use `lenovo search wildcard` when you need to search items with wildcard pattern matching. Required arguments: query. Common flags: --table/-t, --limit/-l, --properties/-p.

search.usage_instructions: `search` commands for `lenovo`. Use this group for the search lenovo surface.

login.help: Configure authentication credentials. Prompts for required credentials based on the tool's authentication type. For OAuth authorization code flows, opens a browser for user consent.

options.name: --profile
options.help: Profile name to save credentials to

login.usage_instructions: Use `lenovo auth login` when you need to configure authentication credentials. Common flags: --profile/-p, --force/-F, --credential-type/-c.

logout.help: Clear stored credentials and browser sessions.

options.name: --profile
options.help: Profile name to clear credentials from

logout.usage_instructions: Use `lenovo auth logout` when you need to clear stored credentials and browser sessions. Common flags: --profile/-p.

status.help: Check authentication status across profiles. Performs a live round-trip for every configured credential type so the report reflects ground truth — not on-disk belief. Saved credentials whose live verification fails are reported as ``authenticated: false`` with the failure reason in ``api_test`` (API/OAuth) or via the live browser check (browser_session).

options.name: --profile
options.help: Profile name to check (defaults to all profiles)

status.usage_instructions: Use `lenovo auth status` when you need to check authentication status across profiles. Common flags: --profile/-p, --table/-t.

test.help: Test authentication by verifying credentials work across profiles.
test.usage_instructions: Use `lenovo auth test` when you need to test authentication by verifying credentials work across profiles. Common flags: --table/-t, --verbose/-v, --profile/-p.

list.help: List all profiles and show which is the default.

options.name: --limit
options.help: Maximum number of profiles to return

options.name: --properties
options.help: Comma-separated list of fields to include

get.help: Get details for a specific profile.

arguments.name: name
arguments.help: Profile name to get details for

create.help: Create a new profile from .env.example template.

set-default.help: Set a profile as the default (IS_DEFAULT_PROFILE=1).

arguments.name: name
arguments.help: Profile name to set as default

delete.help: Delete a profile and its data.

profiles.usage_instructions: Use `lenovo auth profiles` when you need to manage authentication profiles.

auth.usage_instructions: Authentication commands for `lenovo`. Use `lenovo auth login`, `lenovo auth status`, and nested `auth profiles` commands to manage credentials and profiles.

clear.help: Remove all cached responses. Deletes every file in the cache directory ({storage_dir}/cache/) and reports how many files and bytes were freed.
clear.usage_instructions: Use `lenovo cache clear` when you need to remove all cached responses.

cache.usage_instructions: Cache management for `lenovo`. Use these commands to inspect or clear cached CLI responses when you need a fresh read.

usage_instructions: Use the `lenovo` CLI for cli interface for lenovo (browser automation). Commands follow `lenovo <group> <action>`; check auth first with `lenovo auth status` and prefer `--table/-t` for human review when a command supports it.
